# Gotthard Traffic Live

> Live waiting times, queue length, planned night closures and road status for the Gotthard road tunnel (A2, Switzerland) and the Gotthard Pass mountain road, refreshed every ~3 minutes from official Swiss traffic data.

This is an independent, unofficial project. It is not affiliated with ASTRA (the Swiss Federal Roads Office) or any official authority. For safety-critical travel decisions, use official channels.

Free to quote with attribution and a link to https://gotthard.jubr.app/.

## Pages
- Live dashboard, German (default): https://gotthard.jubr.app/
- Live dashboard, English: https://gotthard.jubr.app/en
- Traffic forecast, German: https://gotthard.jubr.app/forecasts
- Traffic forecast, English: https://gotthard.jubr.app/en/forecasts
- Historic statistics (busiest weekdays, Easter records), German: https://gotthard.jubr.app/statistics
- Historic statistics, English: https://gotthard.jubr.app/en/statistics
- Nerd Mode (365-day data, records, minutes per km, closures, weather), German: https://gotthard.jubr.app/nerd
- Nerd Mode, English: https://gotthard.jubr.app/en/nerd

## Machine-readable data
- Current status (JSON, updated about every 3 minutes): https://gotthard.jubr.app/api/gotthard.php
- Queue length / wait time history, last 24 hours (JSON array of points): https://gotthard.jubr.app/api/history.php
- Aggregated statistics of the last 365 days (JSON, cached 15 min; heatmap, records, asymmetry, minutesPerKm, closures, jamDynamics, dataQuality, last7d, weatherNow): https://gotthard.jubr.app/api/stats.php
- Per-day hourly queue aggregate used by the forecast (JSON, cached 1 h): https://gotthard.jubr.app/api/observed.php
- Collector health (JSON; HTTP 503 when the collector has not succeeded recently): https://gotthard.jubr.app/api/health.php

The current-status JSON has this shape:

```
{
  "updated": "<ISO 8601 timestamp>",
  "source": "opentransportdata.swiss (ASTRA Traffic Situations)",
  "tunnel": {
    "status": "open | congested | restricted | closed | unknown",
    "closureReason": "<string|null>",
    "north": { "queueKm": <number|null>, "waitMinutes": <number|null>, "cause": "<string|null>", "closures": [] },
    "south": { "queueKm": <number|null>, "waitMinutes": <number|null>, "cause": "<string|null>", "closures": [] },
    "plannedClosures": [ <upcoming planned (night) closures, may be empty> ]
  },
  "pass": { "status": "open | closed | restricted | unknown", "note": "<string|null>" }
}
```

"north" refers to the Göschenen portal (Uri/German-speaking side), "south" to the Airolo portal (Ticino/Italian-speaking side). "queueKm" is the reported traffic queue length in kilometers; "waitMinutes" is the estimated additional waiting time. "closureReason" explains a closure when the tunnel status is "closed". "plannedClosures" lists announced upcoming closures.

The history endpoint returns an array of points:

```
{ "t": "<ISO 8601>", "northQueueKm": <number|null>, "southQueueKm": <number|null>,
  "northWaitMinutes": <number|null>, "southWaitMinutes": <number|null>, "status": "<tunnel status>" }
```

## Data source
Traffic situations are sourced from the ASTRA / opentransportdata.swiss "Traffic Situations" open data feed: https://opentransportdata.swiss/en/road-traffic/
The forecast page is a model calibrated on historic TCS queue reports and holiday calendars; it is an estimate, not a live measurement.
